blueprint.label: Blueprint of the entities to display

counters.label: Array of counter badges. Each item: {"emoji":"🪲","label":"Bugs","property":"open_bug_count"}

drillDown.label: Array of drill-down sections. Each item: {"label":"Bugs","blueprint":"jira_bug","query":{"combinator":"and","rules":[...Port search rules...]},"include":["$title","priority"]}. query is optional — a relatedTo filter for the selected entity is always injected automatically.

iconProperty.label: Property key whose value is used for icon lookup (e.g. "language" → Python icon). When unset, only the entity's configured Port icon is used. Falls back to initials when no icon matches.
